messages:
Sam: heads up — seeing a huge burst of TCP connections to the etcd leader in us-west1, apiserver 502s and GPU attach failures. netstat shows ~12k conns to :2379. Anyone touching proxy / kube-proxy / conntrack?
Leila: saw the alert. etcd.conn_queue_length jumped and leader QPS dropped. started a quick dashboard scrub, looks like a sharp spike around 11:02 PDT.
Mike: I deployed a small kube-proxy config tweak ~20m ago to nodepool-proxy-usw1 (adjusted iptables conntrack settings). rolling back now to test.
OpsBot: deploy-service: mike rolled back deploy kube-proxy/nodepool-proxy-usw1 (sha: a1b2c3) — 11:12:07 PDT.
Anita: could be conntrack exhaustion or ephemeral ports. can you paste `cat /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_count` and `nf_conntrack_max` from a problematic node? also `ss -tanp | grep 2379` to see CLOSE_WAITs.
Sam: grabbing values now — nf_conntrack_count=198500, nf_conntrack_max=200000. conntrack list shows lots of ESTABLISHED from kube-proxy to etcd leader.
Kevin: NLB idle timeouts + aggressive client retries often create conn storms. cloud LB default idle is 350s in this region. If kube-proxy is opening new source ports fast, we hit conntrack. also controller-manager restart flood could amplify.
Leila: increased nf_conntrack_max to 600k on a few nodes (`sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=600000`) and restarted kube-proxy on 3 nodes -> connection counts dropped to ~2.5k and apiserver 502s reduced. still seeing watch latency spikes.
Mike: rollback seemed to help but we still have a backlog in controller-manager: `workqueue_depth{queue="node-attach"} = 1120` and attach operations failing with `AttachVolume.Attach failed for volume` logs. that backlog is blocking GPU attach attempts.
Anita: sounds like transient controlplane overload cascaded into attach controller retries. can we throttle provider API retries and increase backoff so we don't hammer etcd during recovery? also consider short-term: increase Dedicated capacity and route attach ops to alternate region/pool.
Kevin: filed a follow-up to ops-runbooks: tune LB keepalive + ensure `HTTP/1.1` keep-alive and close idle sockets after 60s. also add conntrack autoscaling in node bootstrap.
Sam: temporary mitigation applied: conntrack_max increased cluster-wide, kube-proxy rollout completed, controller-manager replicas scaled from 2->4 for 15m to drain backlog. attaching logs snippet:
```
E0314 11:09:33.123 controller.go:245] AttachVolume.Attach failed: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection reset by peer
W0314 11:10:01.456 controller.go:312] workqueue requeue after error, backoff=2s
```
Leila: monitoring shows attach error rate down 80% and apiserver 5xxs almost gone. GPU provisioning backlog still ~300 but processing.
Mike: will open a config PR to make conntrack_max and kube-proxy timeouts templated per region. also plan a canary of LB idle timeout change next week.
Anita: we should add a test to chaos-runbook: simulate conntrack exhaustion and ensure controller manager degrades gracefully.
Kevin: created follow-up ticket INF-4232 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4232) for LB tuning + conntrack autoscale + postmortem. assign SRE-Oncall.
Sam: thanks all — keep an eye on watch latencies and GPU attach queue, I'll update the ticket with timelines. :thumbsup:
